dedupe_keys.name: arcgis public transit tools esri transit network analysis and gtfs realtime connector

description: Esri's public-transit-tools repository holds free sample tools that extend ArcGIS for analysis with public transit data. The Transit Network Analysis Tools work on a transit-enabled network dataset built in ArcGIS Pro: they calculate accessibility matrices over a time window (for example jobs reachable within a commute time), travel time statistics between locations, time-lapse and percent-access polygons of the area reachable by transit, and traversed segments with wait, ride time and run ID. A GTFS Realtime connector for ArcGIS GeoEvent Server polls trip updates, service alerts and vehicle positions. Coverage: any network with GTFS data. Format and access: Python toolboxes in a public repository. Licence and cost: Apache 2.0 for the tools, free, but they need licensed ArcGIS Pro with Network Analyst or GeoEvent Server. Caveats: described as sample tools extending core products. It supports network flow and capacity planning through accessibility analysis. It relates to QGIS, r5r, the GTFS specification and Esri pipeline tools in the catalogue.
